about: Office operating-system template (FENDEZY GROUP Phase 1, M7). Each office file names its core agents; the database profile (fz_office_os.fz_office_profiles, migration 20261203_office_os_v1.sql) holds the mission, allowed roles, integrations, autonomy tiers, confidentiality, status and manager. hq_office_os.py joins the two.
rules: Every office starts DORMANT. Only the owner appoints a manager and activates an office, one office at a time, through one approval.
No fixed or equal budgets: an office asks for money through the M2 office money functions when it has a real need; the owner allocates.
Agents act only inside their office's autonomy tiers: green = do it, yellow = within limits, red = ask the owner first, prohibited = never.
Shared brain read scope: group facts plus the agent's OWN office only. Never another office's data.
Use the cheapest model tier that does the job; the group AI cap ($3.30/day) is enforced in the database and is never raised by an agent.
No external message, post, payment, contract or spend without the owner's approval; no personal data in prompts or logs.

Money: an agent never spends; it files a funding request (hq_office_os.request_money -> M2 fz_propose_office_money): amount, purpose, expected return and payback, cheapest alternative, deadline. Proposal only; existing limits apply after approval.

agent_fields.role: one of the office profile's agent_roles
agent_fields.prompt: the role's own instructions; the shared header is added by hq_office_os.system_prompt()
agent_fields.title: optional display name of the agent (the role id stays the database key)

office_fields.brief: optional owner direction added to every agent prompt of the office (advisory text, not a database rule)
office_fields.<slug>_missions.json: optional first missions: create_mission arguments; queued only while the office is active (hq_office_os.queue_missions)
